summary: Installing no longer needs database admin rights, and gives each part only the access it needs.

new.title: Install without database admin rights
new.text: Your install now sets up its own database, with the least access for each part and you as the first SuperAdmin. The person who installs needs no database rights.

new.title: No temporary firewall opening
new.text: The install no longer opens the database to the installer's machine, and a private install needs no machine inside your network for this step.

new.title: Existing installs keep their setup
new.text: An existing install keeps its database admin. The installer tells you if it continues the old way.
